title: Noise-aware FP8 calibration orchestrator CLI and golden-metric contract for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Jonah Kim
description: Problem statement: We need an operator-friendly calibration orchestrator (CLI + job spec) that performs robust FP8 profile discovery for Hopper GPUs (E4M3 / E5M2), establishes a golden-metric baseline across targeted workloads, and produces validated calibration artifacts plus automatic failover recommendations. The orchestrator must be noise-aware (inject and measure numeric jitter), run cross-workload scoring, and output a human-readable contract that downstream rollout tooling can consume. This ticket implements the CLI, the scheduling strategy, golden-metric computations, and the basic CI gating integrations.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A CLI 'rwi fp8-calibrate' that accepts model, shard-list, workload-set, sample-budget, and noise-profile and emits a calibration artifact (json) and a golden_metrics.csv.
2) Calibration artifact includes per-layer recommended mode (E4M3/E5M2), per-layer scale safety margin, sample-count used, and an activation-confidence score.
3) Golden-metric contract contains workload-level metrics (perplexity delta, token-accuracy, embedding-cosine, latency p95) and a single cross-workload score.
4) End-to-end CI job that runs on PRs: unit tests + an emulated small-sample calibration; PR is blocked on regression gate.
5) Telemetry hooks produce the expected metrics (calib_sample_count, per_layer_confidence, cross_workload_score) to the metrics namespace.
6) Demo run on gpt-1B regression harness shows no metric regressions beyond defined thresholds (see thresholds in technical_notes).
technical_notes:
Design choices and algorithms:
- Sampling strategy: stratified sampling across seq-len buckets and activation magnitude quantiles.
- Noise-aware mode: each sample is calibrated under 3 noise settings (baseline, +stat-noise, -stat-noise) to measure numeric sensitivity; we compute per-layer noise-slope and convert into a safety margin.
- Per-layer selector: score = weighted_sum(quant_error_estimate, noise_slope, activation_dynamic_range_penalty). Layers with score > threshold are biased toward E5M2; low-score layers pick E4M3.
- Cross-workload scoring: compute normalized metrics per workload, then aggregate via weighted harmonic mean to penalize large single-workload regressions.
- Fallback policy: if cross_workload_score < 0.95 or any workload perplexity delta > 2.5%, recommend fallback to INT8 for affected shards or mark model as FP32-only for rollout.
- Safety hysteresis: require sustained degradation over N=3 calibration windows or >2% token-accuracy drop sustained for >30 minutes before automated rollback.
- Artifact format: flat JSON with keys as strings; consumers must validate schema version v1.
- CLI outputs: human summary, artifact path, and a one-line rollout recommendation.
- Telemetry: emit per-layer sample_count, per-layer_noise_slope, per-layer_choice and cross_workload_score to metrics path 'infra.quant.calib'.
risks:
1) False negatives: small sample budgets may overfit the golden-metric and miss edge-case regressions.
2) Noisy environments on multi-tenant nodes may inflate noise-slope causing overly conservative choices.
3) Misinterpretation of cross-workload score by SRE without context (we must include per-workload breakdown).
4) CI emulation may not reflect production latency profiles; require periodic production shadow runs.
5) Telemetry cardinality if per-layer metrics are emitted for very large models; use sampling/aggregation to cap cardinality.
